changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
create or alter view [security].Owners as select r.Id as RuleId, r.Uid as RuleUid, r.RoleId, ro.Uid as RoleUid, ro.Name as RoleName, ro.[Permissions], a.AssetTypeId, a.Id as AssetId, r.SecurityType, r_then.SecurityId, r.IsOverride, r.IsVisible from security.[Rule] r inner join security.[Role] ro on ro.Id = r.RoleId inner join Asset a on a.AssetTypeId = r.AssetTypeId --and a.ID = 1812976 --and r.Id = 24 and r.ApplyToType = 0
-- WHEN: Field Condition cross apply ( select count(1) as ConditionCount from security.[RuleWhen] where Id = r.Id and CheckType = 'F' ) as fc cross apply ( select count(1) as MatchCount from security.[RuleWhen] w inner join FieldType ft on ft.Id = w.FieldTypeId and ft.[Type] <> 'Lookup' inner join Field f on f.FieldTypeId = w.FieldTypeId and f.AssetId = a.Id where w.Id = r.Id and w.CheckType = 'F' and case when w.[Operator] = 1 and f.FormattedValue = w.[Value] then 1 when w.[Operator] = 2 and f.FormattedValue <> w.[Value] then 1 when w.[Operator] = 3 and ft.[Type] = 'Text' and f.FormattedValue like '%' + w.[Value] + '%' then 1 when w.[Operator] = 4 and ft.[Type] = 'Text' and f.FormattedValue not like '%' + w.[Value] + '%' then 1 when w.[Operator] = 5 and ft.[Type] = 'Text' and f.FormattedValue like w.[Value] + '%' then 1 when w.[Operator] = 6 and ft.[Type] = 'Text' and f.FormattedValue like '%' + w.[Value] then 1 when w.[Operator] = 7 and ft.[Type] in ('Date', 'DateTime') and try_cast(f.FormattedValue as datetime) < try_cast(w.[Value] as datetime) then 1 when w.[Operator] = 8 and ft.[Type] in ('Date', 'DateTime') and try_cast(f.FormattedValue as datetime) > try_cast(w.[Value] as datetime) then 1 when w.[Operator] = 10 and f.FormattedValue is not null then 1 --populated else 0 end = 1 ) fv cross apply ( select count(1) as MatchCount from security.[RuleWhen] w inner join FieldType ft on ft.Id = w.FieldTypeId and ft.[Type] = 'Lookup' inner join AssetType lt on lt.Object = ft.LookupObjectType+'Type' and lt.ObjectID = ft.LookupObjectID inner join Asset la on la.AssetTypeID = lt.ID and w.AssetId = la.Id inner join Field f on f.FieldTypeId = w.FieldTypeId and f.AssetId = a.Id where w.Id = r.Id and w.CheckType = 'F' and case when w.[Operator] = 1 and f.Value = la.ObjectID then 1 when w.[Operator] = 2 and f.Value <> la.ObjectID then 1 else 0 end = 1 ) flv
-- WHEN: Relation Condition cross apply ( select count(1) as ConditionCount from security.[RuleWhen] w inner join IntersectType it on it.Id = w.IntersectTypeId and it.SubjectAssetTypeId = a.AssetTypeId and w.Id = r.Id and CheckType = 'R' ) as [rc]
-- WHEN: Relation Condition: Checking Subject cross apply ( select count(1) as MatchCount from security.[RuleWhen] w inner join IntersectType it on w.Id = r.Id and w.CheckType = 'R' and it.Id = w.IntersectTypeId inner join [Intersect] i on i.IntersectTypeId = it.Id and w.[Operator] = 16 and i.SubjectAssetId = w.AssetId and i.ObjectAssetId = a.Id -- 16 = 'In' ) srvIn cross apply ( select count(1) as MatchCount from security.[RuleWhen] w inner join IntersectType it on w.Id = r.Id and w.CheckType = 'R' and it.Id = w.IntersectTypeId inner join [Intersect] i on i.IntersectTypeId = it.Id and w.[Operator] = 17 and i.SubjectAssetId <> w.AssetId and i.ObjectAssetId = a.Id -- 17 = NotIn ) srvNotIn
-- WHEN: Relation Condition: Checking Object cross apply ( select coalesce(Cnt, 0) as MatchCount from ( select count(1) as Cnt from security.[RuleWhen] w inner join IntersectType it on w.Id = r.Id and w.CheckType = 'R' and it.Id = w.IntersectTypeId inner join [Intersect] i on i.IntersectTypeId = it.Id and w.[Operator] = 16 and i.ObjectAssetId = w.AssetId and i.SubjectAssetId = a.Id -- 16 = 'In' ) oo ) orvIn cross apply ( select coalesce(Cnt, 0) as MatchCount from ( select count(1) as Cnt from security.[RuleWhen] w inner join IntersectType it on w.Id = r.Id and w.CheckType = 'R' and it.Id = w.IntersectTypeId inner join [Intersect] i on i.IntersectTypeId = it.Id and w.[Operator] = 17 and i.ObjectAssetId <> w.AssetId and i.SubjectAssetId = a.Id -- 17 = NotIn ) oo ) orvNotIn
-- THEN inner join security.RuleThen r_then on r_then.Id = r.Id where (fc.ConditionCount = fv.MatchCount+flv.MatchCount) and ([rc].ConditionCount = orvIn.MatchCount+orvNotIn.MatchCount+srvIn.MatchCount+srvNotIn.MatchCount)
